# Peking University 2024 年系统成果样本：两个 USENIX 种子的研究全景

> 按本次所选研究模块组织；来源摘述和分析仍需阅读审核状态。

## 研究全景

**来源摘述（待审核）**：本次研究只读取了声明的两个有效 USENIX 种子页面，第三个种子是第一个页面 \#abstract 锚点的重复，已去重。种子 A 为 OSDI '24 的 DistServe 页面，种子 B 为 NSDI '26 的 Harp 页面。按程序化筛选，DistServe 的 BibTeX 标注 year = \{2024\}、month = jul，会议为 OSDI '24，属于 conference\_paper，落在 2024\-01\-01 至 2024\-12\-31 内，因此纳入；Harp 的 BibTeX 标注 year = \{2026\}、month = may，会议为 NSDI '26，超出日期范围，因此排除。在本次声明的种子范围内，只有 1 条记录被纳入，样本计数为 1 个研究族。这个数字只是样本计数，不是 Peking University 2024 年系统成果的现实全集，也不能解释为投入或产出规模。 [citation:1] [citation:2]

**来源摘述（待审核）**：纳入的 DistServe 页面公开的研究方向是 LLM 服务系统：把 prefill 与 decoding 计算拆分到不同 GPU，以消除两阶段干扰，并按应用的 TTFT/TPOT 延迟要求联合优化资源分配与并行策略，再根据集群带宽放置两个阶段。摘要称其相对当时最优系统可服务 7\.4× 更多请求或 12\.6× 更紧的 SLO，同时 >90% 请求保持在延迟约束内。这些是作者在摘要中的自述结论，本次未读全文，不能视为已独立验证。归属方面，页面作者列表显示 Yinmin Zhong、Shengyu Liu、Jianbo Hu、Xuanzhe Liu、Xin Jin 标注为 Peking University，Junda Chen、Hao Zhang 标注为 UC San Diego，Yibo Zhu 标注为 StepFun；这是发表作者列表中的单位署名证据，不构成正式合作协议，也不证明当前任职关系。Harp 页面作者单位为 Tencent 与 Fudan University，未出现 Peking University，因此即使不考虑日期，该页面也不能作为 Peking University 成果的归属证据。 [citation:1] [citation:2]

**证据缺口**：学科与主题口径方面，契约中 disciplines=computer science、topic=系统成果，状态为 requested\_labels\_not\_independently\_classified；本次仅凭 USENIX 系统会议 venue 与摘要文本判断方向，未做独立学科分类，不能声称学科已核实。未取得任何论文 PDF，不能声称已深读，所有内容判断限于摘要页与 BibTeX 元数据。种子之外是否存在其他 Peking University 2024 系统成果未知，未检索；DistServe 的完整作者贡献、资助、引用关系页面未提供，未知；Harp 与 Peking University 是否存在未在作者列表体现的关联无证据，不作推断。因此当前证据只能说明该样本的方向，不能推广为 Peking University 2024 年系统研究的整体布局，也不足以支持演进或合作分析。

token (TTFT) for the prefill phase and time per output token (TPOT) of each request for the decoding phase. In the presence of stringent latency requirements, existing systems have to prioritize one latency over the other, or over-provision compute resources to meet both.

excerpts.quote:
Harp: Improving VPC Network Availability via Efficient Failure Detection and Rerouting in Tencent Cloud
Jiayu Hu, Feng Jin, and Xianping Zhou, Tencent; Kai Zhang, Fudan University; Zhen Shen and Yongkang Luo, Tencent
We present Harp, a mechanism for efficient and robust failure detection and recovery for VPC networks. Unlike previous approaches, Harp does not rely on specific hardware features or transport protocols. Instead, Harp is a lightweight software implementation that identifies feasible physical paths between each pair of communicating hosts and monitors their health states. When network failures occur, Harp can swiftly switch influenced flows from a failed path to a healthy path within a short interval. Harp has been deployed in Tencent Cloud for more than two years and has proven its effectiveness in handling network failures. According to the results from production systems, Harp can significantly reduce the VPC network's outage time by 78.71%-99.97% and essentially bypass failed paths on a sub-second timescale. We also share our experiences of how Harp efficiently detects and handles network failures when deployed in Tencent Cloud.

DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
Yinmin Zhong and Shengyu Liu, Peking University; Junda Chen, UC San Diego; Jianbo Hu, Peking University; Yibo Zhu, StepFun; Xuanzhe Liu and Xin Jin, Peking University; Hao Zhang, UC San Diego
DistServe improves the performance of large language models (LLMs) serving by disaggregating the prefill and decoding computation. Existing LLM serving systems colocate the two phases and batch the computation of prefill and decoding across all users and requests. We find that this strategy not only leads to strong prefill-decoding interferences but also couples the resource allocation and parallelism plans for both phases. LLM applications often emphasize individual latency for each phase: time to first token (TTFT) for the prefill phase and time per output token (TPOT) of each request for the decoding phase. In the presence of stringent latency requirements, existing systems have to prioritize one latency over the other, or over-provision compute resources to meet both.
DistServe assigns prefill and decoding computation to different GPUs, hence eliminating prefill-decoding interferences. Given the application's TTFT and TPOT requirements, DistServe co-optimizes the resource allocation and parallelism strategy tailored for each phase. excerpts.quote:
Harp: Improving VPC Network Availability via Efficient Failure Detection and Rerouting in Tencent Cloud
Jiayu Hu, Feng Jin, and Xianping Zhou, Tencent; Kai Zhang, Fudan University; Zhen Shen and Yongkang Luo, Tencent
We present Harp, a mechanism for efficient and robust failure detection and recovery for VPC networks. Unlike previous approaches, Harp does not rely on specific hardware features or transport protocols. Instead, Harp is a lightweight software implementation that identifies feasible physical paths between each pair of communicating hosts and monitors their health states. When network failures occur, Harp can swiftly switch influenced flows from a failed path to a healthy path within a short interval. Harp has been deployed in Tencent Cloud for more than two years and has proven its effectiveness in handling network failures. According to the results from production systems, Harp can significantly reduce the VPC network's outage time by 78.71%-99.97% and essentially bypass failed paths on a sub-second timescale. We also share our experiences of how Harp efficiently detects and handles network failures when deployed in Tencent Cloud.
